name: HP
design_analysis_text: 現行加拿大英文首頁以 HP 藍色商標與白色導覽列開場，七頁商品輪播之後依序排列六類商品、四款推薦產品、AI 全幅主視覺、兩則新聞與深灰頁尾。採用官方已觀測的 forma-djr 字體、照片、SVG 圖示與精確響應式圖片。390px 版將商品橫列轉為直列，保留輪播第一頁與摺疊式頁尾；選單採滿高白底。此次官方內容已將永續報告更新為 2025 Sustainable Progress Report。
visual_review_text: Owner inspected all four final desktop/narrow paired raster montages and the official/local root menu screenshots. Complete 6 desktop + 7 narrow viewport segments per side cover header through footer. Desktop page heights agree at 3673px; narrow official5802/local5803px has 1px rounding difference. Canonical horizontal-viewport headings exclude offscreen Swiper duplicates, whose positive boxes do not indicate current-slide visibility. Main first-slide copy, imagery, category/product layout, news photos and footer were compared. Root mobile menu opening/closing was exercised; other states remain scoped below.
implementation_method: Fresh genuine Google Stitch desktop/mobile correction retained in full; source-backed local correction of the existing genuine-Stitch implementation uses current official DOM/assets and observed per-width layout.
corrections: Updated 2025 Sustainable Progress Report wording, current report document c09282379 and Cookie Preferences footer label.
Materialized both officially observed lazy news images using preserved originals; images now visible in complete final desktop/narrow renders.
Equalized current official desktop must-have CTA heights, completed narrow white hero background and corrected arrow positioning.
Corrected mobile root menu height, header control visibility and body scroll lock; final actual menu raster inspected.
remaining_differences_and_limits: Narrow page footer ends 1px lower than official due to fractional layout rounding; desktop heights agree.

First carousel slide was fully compared at both widths. The seven-slide controls are retained but this pass did not fully compare every slide, automatic timing, transitions or every nested navigation state.
Root narrow menu open/close was verified. Desktop/nested drawers, footer accordions, country selector, search, cart and sign-in services are outside this main-page review.
Native Stitch exports invented prices and news/card content; raw outputs are preserved unaccepted. Source-backed local corrections are the actual reviewed preview.
Exact font rasterization, physical phone hardware, other viewport widths, external destinations, live transactions and deployed hosted rendering are not certified.
progress_note: Current official homepage and final current-hash local desktop/narrow full-page raster coverage inspected; updated report/link/footer/news media/menu corrections, scoped 1px rounding and UI/service limits; accepted=false.

extra.heading_filter_explanation: Only headings with a positive box intersecting the horizontal viewport are paired; offscreen native Swiper clones are excluded.
